description: This file contains functions for parsing, formatting, and manipulating date and time data within the Git version control system. It includes implementations for converting between timestamp formats, handling various date formats, and calculating relative dates.

methods.name: tm_to_time_t
methods.description: Converts a struct tm to a time_t value without normalizing weekday and yearday.

methods.name: show_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date string based on the specified date mode.

methods.name: date_mode_from_type
methods.description: Creates a date_mode struct from a given date mode type.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a timestamp and formats it into a string buffer.

methods.name: parse_expiry_date
methods.description: Parses a string representing an expiry date into a timestamp.

methods.name: date_mode_release
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a date_mode struct.

methods.name: datestamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string representing the current date and time.
